items.heading: Bihari Mutton Curry
details: Key ingredients: mutton, onion, garlic, mustard oil, whole spices
Brown mutton pieces in hot mustard oil with whole spices.
Add a generous amount of browned onion and garlic paste.
Simmer slowly, adding water gradually, until the mutton is tender.
Cook until the gravy is thick and richly flavored with mustard oil.

items.heading: Tunday Kebab
details: Key ingredients: minced mutton, raw papaya, spices, ghee
Marinate finely minced mutton with a paste of raw papaya and ground spices to tenderize.
Shallow-fry in ghee on a griddle until browned on both sides.
Serve hot with thin rumali roti.

items.heading: Kachori with Aloo Sabzi
details: Key ingredients: flour, moong dal or urad dal filling, potato, spices
Stuff a spiced lentil filling into small dough balls and roll out gently.
Prepare a lightly spiced potato curry as an accompaniment.
Serve the hot kachoris with the potato sabzi.
